content: Treasure every encounter, for it can never recur in this life.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Ichi-go ichi-e (一期一会) — Zen Tea Precept (Sen no Rikyu)
explanation: Originating in the Zen tea ceremony, Ichi-Go Ichi-E reminds us that even when the same people gather in the same room, this exact hour, breeze, and heartbeat will never happen again. Every moment is unrepeatable; to treat it casually is to sleepwalk through life.
practicalInsight: When speaking with a loved one or coworker today, put your phone away. Give them your undivided attention as if this were your only meeting.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life have you been treating as permanent, forgetting that every conversation is a fleeting gift?
